name: CREEK & RIVER Co., Ltd.
summary: CREEK & RIVER Co., Ltd. engages in the production and management of creative artists and agencies, as well as rights management in Japan and internationally. It offers company news department, company press office for recruiting, online event shooting and distribution service, and multi-channel network services; agency services; and rights management services, as well as game, web, advertising and publishing, writer, and performing arts services. The company also offers medical and healthcare; construction; and life sciences and agriculture services, as well as investment business.
